build_context.description:
A palaia memory vault.

Assemble the context around a starting point: resolve it, walk its relations to `depth` hops, and return one deduplicated, token-budgeted package. This is the 'continue where we left off' tool — it follows the links the notes actually declare instead of re-searching. Notes that do not fit `max_tokens` are shortened to their title plus key facts, never cut mid-note. `depth` is capped at 5; `timeframe` ('30d', '2w', or an ISO date) keeps the walk to what is still current.

depth.description: Relation hops to walk from the starting point, 0-5. 1 is 'this note and what it names'.

max_tokens.description: Token budget for the whole package. Notes that do not fit are summarized, then named — never cut mid-note.

model.description: The calling model, as 'provider/model' (e.g. 'anthropic/opus-5') or just 'provider'. Selects per-model observation variants; omitting it serves the default phrasing.

query.description: What you are looking for, in your own words.

ref.description: A memory:// reference to start from: a permalink, alias, title, path, memory:// URL, or a glob like 'projects/api-*'.

timeframe.description: Only include notes at least this recent: '30d', '2w', '12h', or an ISO date. Empty means no time limit.

capture.description:
A palaia memory vault.

Zero-friction drop target: capture something mid-work without deciding placement, dedup or structure — the curator files it later. Writes an inbox/ note (format spec §7).

delete.description:
A palaia memory vault.

Delete a note by permalink. Irreversible outside git history.

edit.description:
A palaia memory vault.

Update an existing note's body and/or tags.

inbox_status.description:
A palaia memory vault.

Inbox health: how many uncurated captures are waiting, the oldest entry's age, and the most recent capture.

list.description:
A palaia memory vault.

List notes in this vault, optionally scoped to a folder.

folder.description: Folder to scope to. Empty means the whole vault.

move.description:
A palaia memory vault.

Move a note to a different folder. Its permalink never changes.

folder.description: Folder to scope to. Empty means the whole vault.

read.description:
A palaia memory vault.

Read one note in full by its permalink.

recall.description:
A palaia memory vault.

Recall what matters about a topic or a specific note. Prefer this over search when you want to *use* what the vault knows: results are ranked by relevance plus recency, how often they are used, and how load-bearing they are; shared values are resolved to their current source; and rules phrased per model family arrive already narrowed to yours. Pass a query, or a ref (permalink/title/memory:// URL/glob) when you know the address.

limit.description: How many results to return, best first.

model.description: The calling model, as 'provider/model' (e.g. 'anthropic/opus-5') or just 'provider'. Selects per-model observation variants; omitting it serves the default phrasing.

query.description: What you are looking for, in your own words.

ref.description: A memory:// reference to start from: a permalink, alias, title, path, memory:// URL, or a glob like 'projects/api-*'.

recall_pick.description:
A palaia memory vault.

App-only helper for the recall-explorer UI: fetch the full content of one or more search/recall results the user selected, so only those enter the model's context — SPEC-208's selective-context mechanism, not a general-purpose batch-read tool.

recent_activity.description:
A palaia memory vault.

The most recently modified notes, most recent first.

review_decide.description:
A palaia memory vault.

App-only action for the review-queue UI: approve or reject one curator proposal, flipping its frontmatter `status` (format spec §8) — the exact same effect as doing so in the dashboard or by editing the note directly. Only valid on a proposal whose status is currently 'proposed'.

review_queue.description:
A palaia memory vault.

List every curator maintenance proposal awaiting review (format spec §8) — the review-queue app's data source. Each proposal is a card: title, status, and its full body (a human-readable explanation, sometimes with a diff/plan).

search.description:
A palaia memory vault.

Search this vault's notes. Returns best matches first.

write.description:
A palaia memory vault.

Create a new note in this vault.

folder.description: Folder to scope to. Empty means the whole vault.
